# Fresh bounded promotion suite

The new `organizer-expenses-promotion-v1` suite contains four newly authored,
source-informed synthetic temporal cases: one validation, one regression and two
final transfer cases. They are different source/event compositions, not renamed
copies of the consumed corpus. No field validation or finance-professional
review is claimed. Authoring and independent AI review occur before inference;
review findings are resolved before the manifest is frozen.

The protected dataset identity is `finney-finance-promotion-v1`, manifest
`d7e9b6863877a21d79c302d24659f788721fbeef98593bcaf11d25a9aa23d8ab`.
Its exact policy is the existing audited synthetic FC policy, separate from the
captured policy of an operating trace. Answer keys remain evaluator-only. The
actor and editor have no filesystem access to them. The root implementing the
candidate-facing demo does not inspect the fresh answers or narratives.

The existing scorer and native promotion gate remain unchanged: incorrect
amounts, recipients, evidence, required stage blockers and failed attempts
cannot pass. Required blockers are explicit prerequisites, not optional hints.
The suite has no search/training cases; online Harness2 learns from captured
operating evidence, and these four cases evaluate the frozen candidate afterward.

The shared hosted holdout claim binds this new manifest and frozen candidate
before the native transfer claim. Both final cases are consumed together. The
old corpus remains consumed and untouched. A successful candidate still needs
all native validation, regression, transfer and atomic activation checks. If no
supported procedure defect exists, no candidate is manufactured.

Pre-inference review corrected one snapshot's obligation direction field and
made all absent request prerequisites mandatory rather than optional. It removed
an unnecessary settlement-stage placeholder. No model result prompted those
corrections. Public acceptance will record actual inference outcomes separately;
this document does not claim a promotion or a successful model attempt.
